headline: Godcrofts Ignites with Base Swaps as Callahan's Passage Casualties Mount
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, Godcrofts has abruptly ignited into high activity, logging six base transitions over the last two hours amid sharp fighting around Isawa and The Axehead. Western fighting has simultaneously intensified in Callahan's Passage, where casualty rates surged drastically with more than twenty-five hundred combined losses in two hours alongside fresh combat at The Latch. Central and eastern friction remains unrelenting on Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf, both sectors recording steady base exchanges across Wightwalk, Breaker Town, and The Pale House while maintaining contested lines and unsettled neutral ground. Stonecradle and Marban Hollow registered renewed ownership turnover at Mox and Trammel Pool, and Viper Pit sustains heavy attrition around Blackthroat. In contrast, strategic base shifts in Linn of Mercy ground to a halt across the past two hours, though casualty acceleration across its front lines remains among the heaviest on the continent.
